turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Monday. How is your week starting out?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's starting out pretty busy. I had a lot of emails to catch up on at the logistics firm this morning, but I managed to fuel up with an oat milk latte first.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: An oat milk latte sounds like the perfect way to tackle a busy Monday morning. Are you working from the office today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am. They have the AC blasting as usual, so I'm wearing an oversized hoodie to stay warm at my desk.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move, office AC can be absolutely freezing, especially during the Austin summer. Did you manage to get a decent break for lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I brought a homemade salad today and ate it outside for a bit to get some actual sunlight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice, a homemade salad is a great lunch choice. How are things going outside of work? Are there any new updates on Ana's wedding planning for November?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, things are starting to pick up. She's finalizing the catering details now, so she's actually been asking me for some input on vegetarian options.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great that she's loopng you in! Have you had any time for guitar or rock climbing lately, or has life been too hectic with work and wedding prep?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually went rock climbing with Sam yesterday. It was a really good session, though my forearms are definitely feeling it today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oof, the post-climb soreness is no joke! It sounds like you had a nice weekend, though. I hope the rest of your Monday goes smoothly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm going to head back to my desk and power through the rest of the afternoon. Talk to you later!
